description: Footprint catalog for the auto-solver (B-track). Mirrors the hardcoded FOOTPRINTS object in ada_encyclopedia/src/app/editor/page.tsx — same names, same shapes — but exposed as data the server can consume. The solver in /api/maps/solve-from-artifacts reads `connectors` to know each filler's footprint, and `platform_to_connector` to auto-pick which connector belongs under each artifact based on its spatial_needs.platform.

plane.label: Plane
plane.notes: Flat single-cell floor tile. Default gap between artifacts.

floor.label: Floor pad
floor.notes: Flat 3×3 pad. Used under omni-approach artifacts that want a generous apron.

pedestal.label: Pedestal
pedestal.notes: Raised 3×3 platform with the artifact stamped on top (h=2) and a 1-cell apron at h=1 around the edge.

panel.label: Panel
panel.notes: Facade strip — artifact backed against a wall. Used for artifacts with facade_wall platforms.

atrium.label: Atrium
atrium.notes: Open courtyard, optional walls at perimeter. Larger gathering space.

grove.label: Grove
grove.notes: Informal cluster. Flat floor with optional plant-painting around the edges.

spawn.label: Spawn pad
spawn.notes: End-cap that auto-prepends to the chain. Carries the spawn utility.

teleport.label: Teleport pad
teleport.notes: End-cap that auto-appends. Carries the teleporter utility (target filled at save time).

platform_to_connector._note: Maps the artifact registry's spatial_needs.platform string to a connector id. The solver places this connector UNDER the artifact (i.e. the artifact stamps onto the connector's top cells). When the platform is unknown / missing, the _default is used.

solver_defaults._note: Knobs the solver reads when no override is passed.
solver_defaults._axis_options: x | z — direction the chain extends in the grid
